reflexes.name: long-thread
reflexes.about: The conversation is still very long after its older part was summarised.

action.body: This conversation is very long (the last request was over about 150,000 tokens) even with its older part summarised. Do what was asked. Before you end the turn, make sure what is worth carrying is kept where it lasts: where work stands in your context note, and any rule the owner set in the standing instructions (standing_update). Do not suggest starting a new conversation.
